flow: rev6-p4-mobile-proof · built-in pack: a world started with New game on the built-in aether-land gets its cartridge pack announced by its owner's device once it is shared, and a phone draws its land

env.driver: $PK/run.sh <port> <run file> <tag> [invite file] (bp-tools.txt): cdp-drive.ts with literal replaces of __INVITE__, __SHOTS__, __TAG__ and /__REPO__ (= $PK/snap)

model: none: A's inference.json names a loopback port nothing listens on, the HUD said "UNREACHABLE llamacpp · local" and "No model calls counted for this world yet.", and udA has no usage.jsonl at the end. The service and the page never call a model.

launch the phone on $PK/chrome-1; run.sh 9344 run-bp-3-phone-join-none.json bp-old $PK/invite-w1.txt

stop everything: close-browser.ts 9343 (twice this run, see result.md), the phone, then the page and service by their ports; lsof on 9343, 9344, 8799, 5192 and 5193 finds nothing
